user.title: Theme Studio
user.description: Install Theme Studio services and asset bootstrapper.

error.single_instance_allowed: Only one Theme Studio instance is allowed.

init.title: Theme Studio options
init.description: Control how Theme Studio reinstalls managed assets.

initialize_assets.name: Initialize assets
initialize_assets.description: Install or update the bundled Theme Studio files in /config. User themes are never overwritten.

overwrite.name: Overwrite managed files
overwrite.description: Update bundled files that already exist.

reinstall_assets.name: Reinstall assets
reinstall_assets.description: Force reinstall the bundled Theme Studio files. User themes are never overwritten.

generate.name: Generate live theme
generate.description: Build Theme Studio Dynamic from the current editor values and reload themes if it changed.

save_preset.name: Save user theme
save_preset.description: Save the editor values as a user theme.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Theme name, active variant and the light/dark settings.

copy_preset.name: Copy preset
copy_preset.description: Create a new user theme from a preset or user theme.

source.name: Source
source.description: Preset or user theme to copy.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the new user theme.

delete_user_theme.name: Delete user theme
delete_user_theme.description: Delete a user theme and its built theme file.

build_theme.name: Build theme
build_theme.description: Export a preset or user theme as a Home Assistant theme with light and dark mode.

name.name: Name
name.description: Preset or user theme to build.

refresh_catalogs.name: Refresh catalogs
refresh_catalogs.description: Re-read presets, user themes and background images.

copy_variant.name: Copy variant
copy_variant.description: Copy the saved light or dark variant to the other one and open it in the studio. Lightness is mirrored and light/dark-specific colours are reset to auto, so the copy stays readable. Save the theme to keep it.

source.name: Source
source.description: Variant to copy from: light or dark.

undo.name: Undo
undo.description: Return the studio editor to the previous step (up to 25 steps since Home Assistant started).

export_user_theme.name: Export user theme
export_user_theme.description: Write a user theme to /config/www/theme_studio/exports and return it as JSON and as a share string. A notification links to the file.

import_user_theme.name: Import user theme
import_user_theme.description: Create a new user theme from JSON or a share string. Without data, every .json/.txt file in /config/theme_studio/imports is imported. Existing user themes are never overwritten; a name that is taken gets a number.

data.name: Data
data.description: Exported JSON or a share string starting with TS1:.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name for the new user theme. Defaults to the name in the data.

palette_from_image.name: Colours from image
palette_from_image.description: Read the main colours of a background image and suggest a base colour, an accent and the background contrast.

image.name: Image
image.description: File name in /config/www/background. Defaults to the selected background image.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: Put the suggestions into the studio editor. Undo brings the previous colours back.

set_options.name: Set options
set_options.description: Replace the options of a Theme Studio select.

not_loaded.message: Theme Studio is not set up.

invalid_payload.message: The payload must be an object with the theme settings.

preset_not_found.message: Preset or user theme {name} was not found ({error}).

invalid_import.message: This is not a Theme Studio theme ({reason}).
